script:
Script of the comfort advice (comfort): comfort: a room turning cold, warm or humid, and what would help, from the thermometers and the ventilation units' state
- move ask comfy: "{R} is comfortable."; needs cmd comfort(R), chill(not cold,R) (kept), heat(not warm,R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask cold: "{R} is cold."; needs cmd comfort(R), chill(cold,R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask maybe cold: "{R} may be cold: its thermometer's reading is borderline or old, so I am not sure."; needs cmd comfort(R), chill(maybe cold,R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask warm: "{R} is warm."; needs cmd comfort(R), heat(warm,R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask maybe warm: "{R} may be warm: its thermometer's reading is borderline or old, so I am not sure."; needs cmd comfort(R), heat(maybe warm,R) (kept); leaves said(comfort).
- move ask untracked: "I can't tell: {R} has no thermometer, or its last reading is too old."; needs cmd comfort(R), untracked(R) (kept); leaves refused(comfort).
- move ask unknown: "I can't tell: there is no such room in this home."; needs cmd comfort(rx); leaves refused(comfort).
- move warm start: "{R} is getting warm and its ventilation is stopped: shall I start it?"; needs got warm(R), heat(warm,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(off,U) (kept); leaves advise air(R).
- move warm running: "{R} is getting warm; its ventilation is already running."; needs got warm(R), heat(warm,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(on,U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move warm unconfirmed: "{R} is getting warm; its ventilation has not confirmed its last switch, so I advise nothing yet."; needs got warm(R), heat(warm,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(unconfirmed,U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move warm no unit: "{R} is getting warm and has no ventilation unit: opening a window would help."; needs got warm(R), heat(warm,R) (kept), no unit(R); leaves advise open(R).
- move warm unsure: "{R} may be getting warm; the reading is borderline, so I advise nothing yet."; needs got warm(R), heat(maybe warm,R) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move cold heat: "{R} is getting cold and its ventilation runs without the heater: shall I turn the heater on?"; needs got cold(R), chill(cold,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(on,U) (kept), heater off(U) (kept); leaves advise heater(R).
- move cold heating: "{R} is getting cold; the heater is already on."; needs got cold(R), chill(cold,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), heater on(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move cold stopped: "{R} is getting cold; its ventilation is stopped."; needs got cold(R), chill(cold,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(off,U) (kept), heater off(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move cold unconfirmed: "{R} is getting cold; its ventilation has not confirmed its last switch, so I advise nothing yet."; needs got cold(R), chill(cold,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(unconfirmed,U) (kept), heater off(U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move cold no unit: "{R} is getting cold and has no ventilation unit."; needs got cold(R), chill(cold,R) (kept), no unit(R); leaves noted(R).
- move cold unsure: "{R} may be getting cold; the reading is borderline, so I advise nothing yet."; needs got cold(R), chill(maybe cold,R) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move humid start: "{R} is getting humid and its ventilation is stopped: shall I start it?"; needs got humid(R), damp(humid,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(off,U) (kept); leaves advise air(R).
- move humid running: "{R} is getting humid; its ventilation is already running."; needs got humid(R), damp(humid,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(on,U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move humid unconfirmed: "{R} is getting humid; its ventilation has not confirmed its last switch, so I advise nothing yet."; needs got humid(R), damp(humid,R) (kept), unit in(U,R), power(unconfirmed,U) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- move humid no unit: "{R} is getting humid and has no ventilation unit: opening a window would help."; needs got humid(R), damp(humid,R) (kept), no unit(R); leaves advise open(R).
- move humid unsure: "{R} may be getting humid; the reading is borderline, so I advise nothing yet."; needs got humid(R), damp(maybe humid,R) (kept); leaves noted(R).
- things it counts: occupied; empty; vacant; unsensed; someone home; nobody home; home unsensed; day; night; running; stopped; heater on; heater off; unit ok; unit missing; on b; power; entered; left home; came home; dawn; cold room; comfy room; warm room; untracked; humid room; fresh room; humidity unknown; got cold; got warm; got humid; cmd comfort; said; refused; advise air; advise heater; advise open; noted; cold b; warm b; humid b; chill; heat; damp
